I’ll first inspect #31, current upstream, and the fork’s implementation, then write the Step 0 assessment before changing code. I’ll keep all changes local and run the required checks through dispatch gates.Step 0 found one current merge conflict, in `src/index.ts`, where upstream moved parsing into `startupSettings`. Upstream has inline uploads but no local-path reader.

The existing #31 adds 399 net production lines across 7 production files—already beyond the brief’s limit. Its Linux/macOS race protection uses a Python worker. I’m stopping before coding to report the choices: retain that design with an approved scope increase, or agree on a smaller feature/platform contract. There are three author comments and no maintainer or automated review comments.The manager confirmed the stop: no production code and no platform decision without the owner. I’m finishing the options report.

A small scratch probe also demonstrated why `O_NOFOLLOW` plus `dev`/`ino` comparison is insufficient on its own: swapping an ancestor directory to a symlink can make both the open and the comparison resolve outside the allowed root. I’ll distinguish that limitation from designs that check the opened descriptor’s location.
